CustomField.description: The engine's in-memory background-job id for this document's ingest run (returned by POST /policy/ingest, polled via GET /policy/ingest/status/{jobId}). Set by PolicyIngestQueueable when it submits the job, cleared once the job reaches a terminal state (done/failed). Ingestion is async because a 40-100 page PDF can take longer to parse/embed than Salesforce's 120s callout ceiling allows.
CustomField.label: Ingest Job Id
